categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily engages in the research, development, production, and sales of ecological functional polyurethane synthetic leather and composite materials. Its main products include ecological functional polyurethane synthetic leather and composite materials, serving industries such as functional footwear, sofa home furnishings, automotive interiors, electronics, sports equipment, and engineering decoration.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced technologies including water-based, solvent-free, TPU, bio-based, silicon-based, and recycled materials in its production processes. It employs flexible production systems driven by sales orders, with a focus on high-performance, multifunctional, and eco-friendly polyurethane composite materials. The company also integrates polyurethane resin production with synthetic leather manufacturing for synergistic innovation.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include global and domestic high-end brands in footwear (Nike, Adidas, Puma, Anta, Li Ning), sofa home furnishings (Ashley, Cheers, Kuka, Sophia), automotive manufacturers (Toyota, BYD, Xpeng, Great Wall), and electronics (Apple, Samsung, Google). The company serves both domestic and international markets, with a significant export proportion to developed countries.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with headquarters and main production facilities in Hefei, Anhui Province. It has established subsidiaries in Russia and Vietnam to leverage regional advantages and expand overseas markets. Its sales network covers domestic markets and multiple international regions, supporting a dual circulation strategy.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates mainly in the midstream segment of the polyurethane synthetic leather supply chain, focusing on manufacturing ecological functional synthetic leather and composite materials. It also controls upstream polyurethane resin production through its subsidiary, enabling integrated supply chain management.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include innovation in ecological functional materials, green manufacturing technologies (water-based, solvent-free, bio-based), and high-performance composites. The company invests over 5% of revenue in R&D, focusing on product upgrades for footwear, sofa, electronics, automotive interiors, and emerging TPU applications. It aims to lead global technology with continuous development of new materials and processes.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of synthetic leather and composite material products to brand customers and authorized distributors. The company emphasizes direct sales contracts with downstream customers and their designated manufacturers, supplemented by distributor sales. Revenue is recognized upon transfer of control of goods.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading player in the global polyurethane synthetic leather industry, recognized as the largest scale producer in China and a national manufacturing champion. It holds a top position in domestic market share and high-end segments, with strong brand recognition and technological leadership. Competitors include other synthetic leather manufacturers primarily in Zhejiang, Jiangsu, Guangdong, and Fujian provinces.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 2.4 billion, a 20.12% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 194 million, up 174.19%. It maintains strong asset base with total assets over RMB 2.4 billion and net assets of RMB 1.43 billion. The company shows robust growth in sales volume, revenue, and profitability, supported by increased R&D investment and operational efficiency.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company differentiates itself through ecological functional polyurethane synthetic leather products that offer superior aesthetics, multifunctionality, environmental friendliness, and high performance. It emphasizes green manufacturing processes, compliance with international environmental standards, and customization capabilities. Its products meet stringent requirements of global brand customers, providing competitive advantages in quality, innovation, and sustainability.
